reviewNote: Curated temporal intervals for a small, illustrative subset of the Companies Act, 2013, drawn from public commencement notifications (Section 1 in force 30 Aug 2013; 98 sections from 12 Sep 2013; the bulk, including Section 135, from 1 Apr 2014). Intervals are half-open [effectiveFrom, effectiveTo). This subset is for demonstrating version-aware retrieval and boundary tests; it is not a lawyer-certified commencement/amendment record, and amendment intervals after 2014 are deliberately left open where not verified.

versions.summary: Section 135 was enacted but not yet notified; the mandatory CSR-spend regime under the 2013 Act was not in force before 1 April 2014.
versions.sourceNote: MCA commencement notifications brought most operative sections into force from 1 April 2014.

versions.summary: From 1 April 2014, companies meeting the net worth (Rs 500 crore), turnover (Rs 1000 crore), or net profit (Rs 5 crore) thresholds must constitute a CSR Committee and spend at least 2% of the average net profits of the three immediately preceding financial years on CSR.
versions.amendedBy: Later Companies (Amendment) Acts refined unspent-CSR treatment; those changes are not modelled in this curated subset.
versions.sourceNote: Threshold and 2% figures verified against the bundled Section 135 source text.

provisions.heading: Company to have Board of Directors

versions.summary: Board composition requirements: minimum three directors (public), two (private), one (OPC); maximum fifteen without a special resolution; independent-director and woman-director requirements for prescribed classes.
versions.sourceNote: Composition rules verified against the bundled Section 149 source text; independent-director provisions were notified from 1 April 2014.
